Help kids manage big emotions, build self-control, and choose safe, positive behaviors with this English-Spanish bilingual picture book.

Strong feelings are a natural part of growing up—but hitting is not okay. Hands Are Not for Hitting / Las manos no son para pegar is an engaging English-Spanish bilingual picture book that helps children ages 4–7 understand their emotions and learn safe, respectful ways to respond.
